verses: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
For Thou art the God of my strength: why dost Thou cast me off? why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?
O send out Thy light and Thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me to Thy holy hill, and to Thy dwelling places.
Then will I go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy: and I will praise thee with the lyre, O God my God.
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why dost thou moan within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
